narration: Erling Haaland just silenced the doubters. Two goals as Norway stunned Brazil 2-1, reaching the World Cup quarter-finals for the first time ever. Just thirty touches all game, and he barely needed them. Seven goals now, level with Mbappe and Messi for the Golden Boot. England are next. Norway believe anything is possible.
title: Haaland STUNS Brazil — Norway's First-Ever World Cup Quarter-Final! 🇳🇴🔥
description:
Erling Haaland scores twice as Norway beat Brazil 2-1 to reach the World Cup quarter-finals for the first time ever — and moves level with Mbappe and Messi on seven goals.
